page.overview:
Who is Lucius?

Lucius is a recurring character appearing in . He is one of the main reasons Roy wanted to become a Pokémon trainer. He is also Liko's great-great-grandfather.

Lucius is a young man who bears a close resemblance to Liko with a light complexion and light blue eyes. He has bright azure hair resembling Liko's haircut, tied back in a braid. He has a skinny build. He has a blue-and-gold striped cape, gold-accented brown boots, and black gloves with diamond appendages.

Lucius is a kind, brave man with a strong sense of determination. As the leader of his team, he cherishes his companions deeply and always treats others politely.

Lucius is derived from the Latin word for "light".
